question:
Select the option that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

D3K, E5J, F7I, G11H, ?
solution:
Explanation:-

According to the English alphabets and their positional values:**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 
The pattern followed in the given codes is:

 
• First alphabet is increased to 1 positional values.
 
• Numbers are prime number series, starting by 3
 
• Last alphabet is decreased by 1 positional values.**

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e8e69d96c3be3fb0effe928ed05d68e0cd02580a30708af1b762985af46a561.png] 

**Hence the correct answer is option 1.**
